signals.text: Konsa and O'Reilly doubts to face Czech Republic. Ezri Konsa and Nico O'Reilly are both doubts to play in England's Nations League match against the Czech Republic on Tuesday night.
Barcelona monitor Chelsea's Estevao - Monday's gossip. Barcelona are monitoring Estevao, Erling Haaland attracts interests amid Man City uncertainty and Joao Felix could return to Europe, plus more.

Chelsea restore resilience - are they title contenders again?. Doubt crept in at Chelsea last season when they lost their Women's Super League crown - but early signs in this campaign suggest they have regained their spark for another challenge.
